mission: Distillation targets ONLY (local data artifact, KHONG training): tao soft-target files de model student TUONG LAI distill kien thuc v38-ensemble thay vi ListNet-tren-raw-labels. KHONG fit bat ky student nao o day.
owner: R-DIAGNOSTIC worker (scorediag v100: mechanism value-prior neo magnitude + regularize order; v38-only top-decile +0.196% vs v55c-only -0.727%)
mechanism_recap: Value-prior giup ranking vi cho encoder gradient tuyet doi doc lap tren MOI candidate (neo magnitude), vua regularize thu tu within-decision vua lam score lien-decision muot/so sanh duoc (standardized mean|d| 0.410 vs 0.677, thang 11/11 folds). Rank-only ListNet chi hoc thu tu tuong doi qua softmax nen margin lien-decision la jitter ordinal, top-picks am (top-decile +0.204% vs -0.493%, v55c-only -0.727%). Implication: distill rank-head tren soft-target E38 (giu neo magnitude) thay vi ListNet tren label tho.

inputs.v38_source: artifacts/kaggle/v38_rankloss_download/rankloss-training (DA VERIFY: 33 predictions.npy (n_test,16,6) map-v8, 3 seeds x 11 folds)
inputs.v38b_policy_ref: artifacts/research/opencode_v38b_replay/audit.json (DA VERIFY: policy ensemble mean_3seeds combine penalty 0.0; gate en_best>0.0 + fallback top-8/fold-test; candidate argmax expected s.t. fill>=0.25). Policy nay la context cho student TUONG LAI, KHONG ap policy len soft-targets (soft-targets bao toan full (n,16)).
inputs.labels: data/processed/swing_regime_research_v4/examples.npz (DA VERIFY: labels (5628,16,3) float32; ch0 unconditional net %, ch1 fill, ch2 positive-net; exploratory)

ensemble.method: VERBATIM audit v38b: mean 3 seeds qua agentic_alpha_lab.models.ensemble_value.combine(stacked, 0.0); E38 = details[mean_expected_net_percent] (n,16), expected = ch0*sigmoid(ch4) per seed
ensemble.assembly: per-fold concat theo thu tu fold 0..10 (khop partition chronological + label_end < complete_evaluation_until); assert moi fold file length == partition length; assert finite; assert n == 4076

temperature.why_past_folds: Cloud export chi co test-fold predictions, KHONG co validation predictions (gioi han da biet tu v38b audit: calibrate-first KHONG kha thi voi export hien tai). Nen validation cho tau_f = cac test-folds QUA KHU (fold_of < f) — strictly causal, no test peek.
temperature.per_fold: tau_f fit tren rows co fold_of < f; fold 0 khong co qua khu -> fallback tau=1.0 (ghi ro fallback, khong peek).
temperature.objective: NLL (cross-entropy) cua softmax(E38/tau) vs hard oracle class = argmax_k truth ch0 (first-max deterministic) tren validation-qua-khu; chon tau argmin NLL (first-min tren grid). Day la temperature scaling chuan (Guo et al. 2017) ap cho teacher top-1 calibration.
temperature.numerics: stable log-softmax (tru max per-row); clip prob 1e-12 khi tinh NLL; E38 don vi % net.
temperature.record: taus.json: per-fold {tau, n_val, fallback, nll_per_tau, top1_conf_mean, top1_accuracy, cal_gap=|conf-acc|} + grid + objective + fallback rule

soft_targets.formula: soft[i,:] = stable_softmax(E38[i,:] / tau_{fold_of[i]}) per decision; float32 (n,16); moi row sum-to-1 (assert allclose 1e-5).
soft_targets.bundle_npz: soft_targets.npz keys: soft_targets (4076,16 float32), teacher_expected_net (4076,16 float32, E38), fold_of (4076 int64), indices (4076 int64, vi tri vao decisions_all/examples), tau_per_row (4076 float64), oracle_top1 (4076 int64, argmax ch0 first-max)

teacher_diagnostic.question: Teacher co thang hard labels tren validation khong? Neu teacher thua o dau thi ghi trung thuc o do.
teacher_diagnostic.definitions: teacher_top1 = argmax E38 (first-max); oracle_top1 = argmax truth ch0 (first-max, dung future -> chi mo ta exploratory, KHONG lam rule); uniform_baseline = mean truth ch0 tren 16 candidates/decision (no-skill baseline).
teacher_diagnostic.loses_where: folds co teacher_realized_mean < uniform_realized_mean HOAC agree_rate < chance -> liet ke explicit trong teacher_diagnostic.json (honest, khong giau).
teacher_diagnostic.scope: mo ta tren moi fold test-decisions (exploratory labels, giong pattern v100) + luu y taus fit past-only nen diagnostic doc lap voi fitting.

student_spec_future.note: CHI spec cho TUONG LAI, KHONG thuc thi o v101 (no student training).
student_spec_future.loss: L = KL(softmax(student_logits) || soft_targets co dinh) + lambda_rank * ranking_loss(student_logits, hard labels); KL la so hang chinh (distill magnitude-neo tu E38), ranking-on-hard la so hang nho giu ap luc thu tu.
student_spec_future.lambda_rank_suggestion: 0.1-0.25 (nho hon ranking 0.5 cua v38 vi soft-target da chua tin hieu thu tu; tune tren validation past-only, KHONG tune tren test).
student_spec_future.temperature_handling: soft_targets da scale boi tau_f o v101 -> student hoc voi KL o T=1 (khong them temperature nua); student logits tu do, khong rang buoc don vi %.
student_spec_future.architecture: architecture-free: bat ky head nao output (n,16) logits (SSM/TCN/GRU/MLP deu duoc; khuyen nghi giu encoder family ~0.6M Selective-SSM de so sanh cong bang voi v38/v55c).
student_spec_future.causality: train/val chi rows co label_end < fold_start - 8d embargo (nested_split past-only); normalization fit train-only; khong chon seed/fold/epoch/threshold theo PnL; labels exploratory.
student_spec_future.budget: Heavy training CHI tren Kaggle PRIVATE (T4x2, <=10 GPU-h, fixed epochs, khong early-stop theo PnL); local GTX1650 chi inference/replay/backtest; tua theo AGENTS.md compute preference 2026-09-06.
student_spec_future.eval: replay parity (rtol/atol 1e-3) + portfolio 2 branches (1x, dd_guard) x 3 scenarios + gate monthly>=5%/DD<=20%/fills>=30 + diagnostic lens (rank/coverage/bias/topdecile) truoc moi ket luan.
